headline: Philippines Surprises with Jumbo Interest-Rate Hike Amid Surge in Inflation
summary: The Philippines implemented a large interest-rate hike as the country battles war-fuelled price increases, a slumping peso, and risks from El Nino.
why: Central banks use aggressive monetary tightening to curb surging domestic inflation and stabilize local currency values.

impacts.name: Philippines
impacts.why: Higher borrowing costs help contain inflation but can slow domestic economic growth.

why_moved: Unanticipated aggressive monetary tightening directly responds to high inflation prints and currency depreciation pressures.
